newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat has no trades but orders build.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat has no trades but orders build.

text.p: No trades took place in Sydney Futures Exchange wheat on Wednesday although brokers said plenty of orders had begun to come to the market.
Settlement prices, the difference between bid and ask quotes, mostly firmed by A$2.00-A$3.00 a tonne.
Phil Lindsay of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd said end users were returning to the market. "The volume is there and it's a matter of waiting for something to happen," he said.
Traders feared a price slump after the Australian Wheat Board pool price increase of A$1.00 to A$193.00 a tonne and its predicted opening 1997/98 pool at A$170.00-A$180.00, he said.
